lines.speaker: Dominion Scan Agent 1
lines.text: Neural signature flagged. Asset CIPHER. Detain for verification.

lines.speaker: Dominion Scan Agent 2
lines.text: Suspect is mobile! All units converge on platform...

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: Those are local security. My people. Your neural profile triggered our safety protocols.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I didn't mean to alarm them.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: You're augmented. Heavily. That katana isn't ceremonial. So I'm guessing you're either running from something or toward something. Either way, walking through that crowd again is going to end in more security requests.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: I can walk you through the festival grounds. File a false report. You get a few hours before the next sweep.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Why would you do that?

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: Because some part of me recognizes the look. Someone trying to figure out who they are while running from what they were. Come on.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: Aethon-9's spent the last six years building something real. The Dominion actually left us alone to do it.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: That should concern you.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: No one questions Dominion designations on their own land. Those have been sealed for three years. Automated systems handle whatever's down there.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Do you have children? On this world?

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: Let's keep walking.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I need to go down there.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: That's a containment zone. Security drones. You'll trigger an alarm.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: I heard rumors. Kids disappearing from the lower settlements. Explained as scholarships. Dominion generosity.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: That's exactly what they want everyone to believe.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Cipher. Report.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Aethon-9 is running a child-extraction operation. Sealed facility beneath the agricultural sector. I'm reading a manifest now.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Forty-seven children. Ages six to fourteen. Transferred off-world under educational relocation codes.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Cipher... I need to tell you something.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: During my Dominion logistics years, I ran contracts through Aethon-9. Sealed neural crates. Young-sized units. Loading them onto orbital transports.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I never opened them. I didn't want to know what was inside.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I'm sorry. I don't know if that means anything now.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: It means you're going to help me end this. That's what it means.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: How are you doing this? How is your body remembering this?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I don't know. I only remember what I'm doing when I'm doing it.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: Do you remember anything before the Dominion?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Fragments. Phantom reflexes. The certainty I've done this exact thing before.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: There was an orphanage. A command to massacre the children. I refused.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: And the children?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Some survived. The ones I couldn't reach in time did not.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: CIPHER. They assigned you a number instead of a name.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: It's not assigned. It's earned. Every operative in the Program gets a number and a codename and training that strips everything else away.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I was seven. They marked me CIPHER-7. And the file carries the name the syndicates gave me later: the Architect of Mercy. The documentation logs it as a behavioral anomaly they never successfully corrected.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: You remember?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: My body remembers. That's almost worse.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Hold still.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: What were those drones?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Capture units. The Dominion wants me alive. There's a failsafe in my neural implant, a slow purge that started the day I refused the order at Kethel-7. If they can trigger it remotely, they let the purge finish me.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I'm already dying. They just want me to die on their schedule instead of mine.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: Then we're not wasting any more of your time on hesitation.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Transport ship arriving at festival peak. Six hours. They're extracting the children currently staged in the lower hold. Maybe thirty of them. Already prepped for transit.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: We burn the facility. Destroy the manifests. Get the children to the Corsair.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Dominion wired a colony-wide destruct into the facility's power core. If you're captured and the failsafe activates, the whole valley system goes with it.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Aethon-9 is disposable infrastructure to them. We're not staying long enough to matter.

lines.speaker: Dominion Commander
lines.text: CIPHER-7. Confirming asset recognition. Engaging.

lines.speaker: Maya Selene
lines.text: How does someone like you remember anything?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: By being with someone who isn't afraid. Go.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: CIPHER. You're still functioning. I'm almost impressed.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Kethel-7. The orphanage. The order. The massacre. The refusal.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I'm destroying this facility and every manifest in it.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: CIPHER is a compromised asset. The Program's correction was always inevitable. Stand down and accept reclamation.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This ends now.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The children are being routed to safe colonies through Morrigan's contact network. They'll have a chance.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Maya filed a broadcast with the Outer Worlds Council naming the Aethon-9 operation by facility code. She's calling for an investigation.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: What do I remember of Kethel-7 now?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Everything?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The order came in. I refused it. They wiped me for the refusal.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I don't know yet who issued the original command. How far up the chain it reached. Only that it was real. That the children were real. And that I was right to refuse.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I didn't know what was in those crates.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I know. That's what they count on. Everyone looking away. Everyone pretending.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Kessler. Run every operative file we hold against that designation. SISTER-IRON.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: What are you afraid of?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: That I know her.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Aethon-9 was running a harvest operation beneath the festival grounds, a child-extraction facility that mirrors Kethel-7 exactly. Forty-seven children marked for off-world transfer. Kessler learned he unknowingly ran logistics for these operations years ago when he was still Dominion. The underground archive held my file: CIPHER-7, the operative marked at age seven with a behavioral anomaly they never corrected, the refusal to massacre children. I read my own designation for the first time. We got thirty children to safety and pulled fragments of the archive revealing seventeen more harvest installations across the galaxy.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: So the heading is outward and inward both, hunting SISTER-IRON, an operative dispatched by Dominion command to complete your purification. That name carries weight, Cipher. You need to know what you're facing. And we need to find every one of those seventeen facilities before the Dominion decides extraction is less valuable than erasure.
